title.value: In-Processing fairness improvement methods for regression Data-Driven building Models: Achieving uniform energy prediction
title.justification: The title is taken directly from the heading of the paper.
title.quote: In-Processing fairness improvement methods for regression Data-Driven building Models: Achieving uniform energy prediction

extractions.description: The paper addresses the challenges of predictive fairness in regression data-driven building models for energy prediction. It introduces four methods to incorporate fairness in regression model outcomes, specifically for energy predictions in buildings. These methods are applied to linear regression models to ensure uniform energy predictive accuracy regardless of conditions such as occupancy movement. The study evaluates several methods and finds that Mean Square Error Constrained (MSEC) regression effectively improves fairness without significantly reducing accuracy.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on improving energy prediction models for buildings, which is directly related to energy efficiency and, therefore, relevant to sustainable development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: ...energy prediction models could be integrated into model predictive controller to provide optimal control signals for building energy management systems to achieve energy saving...

primary_category.justification: The research focuses on energy prediction for building management systems aimed at energy saving and efficiency, which falls under climate change mitigation efforts.
primary_category.quote: energy prediction models could be integrated into model predictive controller to provide optimal control signals for building energy management systems to achieve energy saving...

secondary_categories.justification: The paper primarily discusses energy prediction related to buildings and does not explicitly address other categories such as adaptation or natural systems protection.

primary_sub_category.justification: The paper discusses methods to improve energy prediction accuracy and fairness, which is a fundamental aspect of enhancing energy efficiency in buildings.
primary_sub_category.quote: ...energy prediction models could be integrated into model predictive controller to provide optimal control signals for building energy management systems to achieve energy saving...

secondary_sub_categories.justification: No other direct sub-categories are addressed; the focus remains on energy efficiency in buildings.

applications.value: Improving operation of heating and cooling systems (HVAC), domestic and industrial
applications.justification: Fair and accurate energy prediction models can optimize HVAC systems' efficiency, reducing energy consumption in buildings.
applications.quote: The abundant data could be utilized to train data-driven models to represent building states, such as indoor air temperature [2], indoor air quality [3], HVAC operation status [4,5], energy consumption [6,7], etc.
